blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police (PNP) urged motorists to observe traffic rules and cooperate with authorities during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit from Nov. 15 to 18. “Let us follow traffic protocols and respect our fellow motorists to avoid any incidents and ensure the safety of all travelers during this time,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. in a statement on Tuesday. “We strongly advise motorists to plan their trips ahead, monitor traffic conditions, and prepare for possible rerouting during the Summit,” added Nartatez.
